workflow_runs.name: blocking-ci
workflow_runs.display_title: MEM7: isolate post-update revocation and preserve recovery evidence

head_commit.message:
test(mem): isolate post-update revocation in fresh public readers

Freeze a readable post-update snapshot and live dependency chain before revoke. Bind each returned receipt to its request and retain process identity on failures. Add a standard-library CI lane and document the actual product memory integration requirements.

Signed-off-by: Qian QI <102159240+ProfHepta@users.noreply.github.com>
